summary: Five hand-drawn style icons used on the tool cards, plus a sixth icon for intelligence, all as simple line drawings.
purpose: Gives each tool a recognizable picture that fits its job.
why: Reason not stated in the code. Likely reason: a consistent visual identity for the tool cards.
how: Each icon is a function that returns a small drawing made of boxes, lines, circles, and paths. Each draws in the color of the surrounding text and can be resized by passing a class name.
inputs: An optional class name that sets the size. Default size is set in each function.
risks: The icons have no text label, so a screen reader gets no description. Changing a coordinate changes the look with no check to catch it.
debug: If an icon does not appear, check that its name is imported where it is used and that the class name is valid. If an icon has the wrong color, check that it inherits the text color of its parent.
